name: The Reckoning
description: Your family hasn't forgotten what you did. The choice you made during the Family Crisis is coming back around.

chapters.title: The Cold Shoulder
chapters.description: You tried reaching out to your family. They're not returning calls. Word gets back that they're talking about you - and it's not good.

choices.label: Make a Real Apology
choices.description: Go in person. Make it right. No excuses.

choices.label: Send a Peace Offering
choices.description: Maybe money can help smooth things over.

chapters.title: Face to Face
chapters.description: You showed up at home. The tension was thick. But you said your piece. Now you wait to see if they can forgive you.

choices.label: Be Patient
choices.description: You said what you needed to say. The ball is in their court.

choices.label: Push for Resolution
choices.description: You can't leave things like this. Keep reaching out.

chapters.title: Money Can't Fix Everything
chapters.description: They took the money but didn't say much. You hear through others that they appreciated it, but they're still hurt.

choices.label: Follow Up in Person
choices.description: The gift opened a door. Walk through it.

choices.label: Keep Sending Support
choices.description: If that's how you can help, keep doing it.

chapters.title: Silence
chapters.description: Weeks pass. Nothing. The silence is deafening. You start to wonder if they'll ever come around.

choices.label: Break the Silence
choices.description: You've waited long enough. Time to reach out.

choices.label: Accept the Loss
choices.description: Maybe some things can't be fixed. Move on.

chapters.title: Building Bridges
chapters.description: There's been some progress. Your family is starting to come around. But trust takes time to rebuild.

choices.label: Commit to Change
choices.description: Promise to be there. And keep that promise.

choices.label: Take It Slow
choices.description: Don't make promises you might not keep.

endings.title: Second Chance
endings.description: You earned back their trust. It took time, effort, and sacrifice - but you proved that family matters to you. The past isn't forgotten, but you're building a better future.

endings.title: Fragile Peace
endings.description: Things are better, but delicate. Your family has forgiven but not forgotten. You're on probation - one wrong move and this could all unravel.

endings.title: Mending Bonds
endings.description: The combination of financial help and showing up in person worked. Your family sees that you're trying. Slowly but surely, you're rebuilding what was broken.

endings.title: The Provider
endings.description: You've become the one who sends money. It's not the relationship you wanted, but it's something. They appreciate your support, even if they keep their distance.

endings.title: Moving On
endings.description: You've accepted that some things can't be fixed. Your family has moved on without you, and you've learned to live with that. It hurts, but you're stronger for it.

endings.title: Cautious Reconnection
endings.description: You're back in touch with your family, but you're keeping expectations realistic. You don't want to promise more than you can deliver. It's progress, if slow.
